name: Mythic Greater Trip (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
You can drive foes to land on the ground in uncoordinated heaps.

Prerequisites: Combat Expertise, Greater Trip, Improved Trip, base attack bonus +6, Int 13.

Benefit(s): When you successfully trip an opponent, the opponent is flat-footed for the attacks of opportunity provoked as a result of being tripped.
